text: I feel enveloped by an atmosphere of curiosity and anticipation. The glass-walled meeting room, with its ordered chairs and a solitary figure preparing within, stirs in me a sense of preparation and potential dialogue. The vibrant, information-rich display in the second space, labeled R+D, speaks to the pursuit of knowledge and innovation. I sense I am in a place where ideas are cultivated and shared—perhaps a museum or a center for research and learning. I feel eager to engage and discover.
